subject: Client orchestration plan: MAP & phase-gate timeline (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>; Jill Park <jill.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 20 May 2029 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Acme Health MAP draft + milestone asks

Hi team —

Following the demo last week, Acme is ready to move to a phase-gate onboarding. Attaching the first-cut MAP (MAP-v1.xlsx) and a light SOW. Key asks from Jill during the call: an explicit data-handling acceptance criteria, a test window for live inference load at day 60, and a single-point escalation for latency regressions.

Summary (high level):
- Kickoff: target week of June 3 (Acme prefers June 4)
- Phase 1 (Pilot, 0–45 days): integration + sandbox validation + security review
- Phase 2 (Scale, 45–90 days): performance tuning, autoscale config, go/no-go cutover
- Cutover target: Aug 1, 2029 (soft go-live), Aug 15, 2029 (full traffic)

Milestones (owners):
1) Kickoff & runbook acceptance — Owner: Marcus Lin — target: 2029-06-04
2) SOC2 evidence handover (customer questionnaire items) — Owner: Monica Patel — target: 2029-06-14
3) Sandbox inference load test (50k tokens/hr) — Owner: Soojin Lee — target: 2029-07-05
4) Performance validation & cost-optimization pass — Owner: Soojin Lee — target: 2029-07-20
5) Cutover dry-run & rollback test — Owner: Marcus Lin — target: 2029-07-28

Acceptance criteria (short):
- End-to-end inference latency < 300ms P95 on pilot traffic
- Model outputs pass baseline prompt set with >95% alignment on intent labels
- Audit logs visible in Acme VPC (or delivered daily) for first 90 days

Next steps for the internal team: please review the MAP tabs I highlighted and comment in the Drive doc by EOD Thursday. Jill — if the dates above look feasible we can lock the kickoff and circulate the full runbook.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP-v1.xlsx (Spreadsheet)] [Attachment: SOW-draft-Acme-Health.docx (Doc)]

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Handoff: Acme Health MAP draft + milestone asks

Monica — thanks for the clear summary and the MAP. A few clarifications from our side after reviewing with ops and procurement: 

- Procurement would like the SOW clause around data retention to call out 90-day logs retention minimum and an option for a 12-month audit bundle. Procurement cc'ed on this thread will send redline suggestions by Wed.
- For the sandbox load test: we can provision a mirrored dataset but need a runbook for how redwood will handle PII tokens (masking approach).
- The kickoff date of June 4 works for product and ops; engineering would prefer June 6 if that makes a difference for your schedule.

One ask: can we add a 14-day "observability smoke" at the end of Phase 1 where Acme and Redwood engineering jointly review traces and per-route cost? We feel that will reduce risk at cutover.

If you can update the MAP and share the Drive link with inline comment permissions, we will route procurement and legal next week.

Best,
Jill Park
Director, Product Ops, Acme Health
jill.park@acmehealth.com
